notes:
What's new in 0.35.0 — Top 10, My Lists as rows, and profile pictures

• Home has Top 10 Films Today and Top 10 Series Today, ranked with big outlined numbers.
• My Lists shows every list as a row, like Home. Show More opens the whole list as a grid.
• With Trakt connected, My List asks which Trakt list to save to.
• Title pages are simpler: just Play, which picks a source for you or opens the list, as set in Settings › Playback. The trailer plays behind the page, so there's no Trailer button.
• Pick a picture for your profile in Settings › Profiles: 17 Zylo characters to choose from.
• Trailers on Home wait until you're in the featured title, not while you're in the top bar.
• Fixes: the app icon in TV Settings, the Fire TV tile now fills the space, a cleaner launch screen, and even spacing next to the title you're on.
